                           Message from the Principal




Dear Students,

It gives me immense pleasure to welcome you to Guwahati College. Our institution has always been
committed to providing quality education, nurturing talent, and shaping responsible citizens for the
future.

At Guwahati College, we believe that education is not limited to academic excellence alone. We
strive to create an environment that encourages critical thinking, creativity, discipline, leadership,
and social responsibility. Along with classroom learning, students are encouraged to participate
actively in co-curricular and extracurricular activities, extension programmes, sports, cultural
events, and community service.

Our dedicated faculty members and staff work tirelessly to ensure that every student receives proper
guidance and opportunities for holistic development. The college also emphasizes values such as
integrity, inclusiveness, respect, and lifelong learning, which are essential in today’s rapidly
changing world.

As you begin your academic journey with us, I urge you to make the best use of the facilities and
opportunities available in the college, maintain discipline, pursue knowledge and contribute
positively to the institution and society.

I am confident that your days at Guwahati College will be enriching, inspiring, and memorable. I
wish you success in all your future endeavors.

With best wishes,

                                                            Principal
                                                            (Dr. Pranab Sandilya)
                                                            Guwahati College

  APPLICATION PROCEDURE

 A candidate shall apply for admission through the Assam State Higher Education
    Admission Portal-SAMARTH PORTAL ONLY (https://assamadmission.samarth.ac.in).
    The link will be available on the college website as well to register and proceed with the further
    application process.
 Admission will be strictly on a merit basis. A confirmation message will be sent to the
    Samarth User ID of the respective candidate. After accepting the offer from the
    concerned Institution, a candidate will be considered as PROVISIONALLY
    SELECTED FORADMISSION.
 The admission committee of the college will conduct physical verification of the relevant
    documents on the day of admission. After successful verification and fee payment, the
    final admission will be confirmed.
 The candidates whose names appear in the merit list but fail to get admitted on the
    specified date will forfeit their claim.
 Reservation of seats for SC, ST (P), ST(H), OBC/MOBC, EWS, PwD, and sports and
    extracurricular activity quota will be done as per Assam Government regulation.


  ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA
A student who has passed the 12th standard or equivalent examination in any stream from a
recognized institution is eligible to apply.
Admission to the FYUGP will be based on the preference of Major, if any. In case a student
does not want to opt for any Major, she/he will be admitted based on preferences of the
subject combinations.
Admission to a programme or major will be subject to the availability of the subject and
capacity of a college/department.
No student shall be eligible for admission to a programme in any discipline under the FYUGP
unless he/she fulfills the pre-requisites of courses as fixed by Gauhati University.

    GUWAHATI COLLEGE: A BRIEF INTRODUCTION

      “GREAT WORKS ARE PERFORMED NOT BY STRENGTH BUT BY
                        PERSEVERANCE.”

Guwahati College, situated in the eastern part of Guwahati is one of the premier institutions
of Assam for higher learning in the region. It has a strength of nearly three thousand students,
who are ably guided towards the achievement of their goals by a highly qualified and
experienced teaching community.
   The College was established on 3rd August 1964 at Chandmari, Guwahati. Later, it was
shifted to its permanent building in Bamunimaidam at Jyotinagar. The College has
successfully completed 60 years of its glorious existence since 1964. It is now one of the
most reputed Colleges of Assam where students from all over the Northeast and other states
of India get admitted. Each year a good number of undergraduate students get enrolled in
master’s programs offered by several state and national educational institutions.
   Guwahati College has completed 60 glorious years of existence and was re-accredited
(Cycle 3) by NAAC with Grade B++ with a CGPA of 2.91 in 2023. The College now stands
as a full-fledged Institution of higher learning equipped with the latest educational
technology. The infrastructure reflects the development of the College with its well-stocked
library, departmental libraries, seminar halls, well-equipped laboratories, and a beautiful
playground. The College has its own unique Anthem. At present, Guwahati College has three
streams in the degree course-Arts, Science and Commerce.


The Mission of the College:
The mission of the College is to TEACH. The term here stands for:
 Transformation of the society through the spread of knowledge.
 Education of the youth and development of personality.
 Acquisition of skills by learners.
 Creation of dedicated human resources.
 Helping nation-building.


The Vision of the College:
Guwahati College has the vision to attain the status of an autonomous educational institution
with all its stakeholders making substantial differences in our modes of thinking and patterns
of living. The College wants to ensure that the real fruits of modern education spill over the

                                                                                                   10
 confines of the classroom, resulting in the well-being of the planet and all things living.
Guwahati College attempts to understand the social needs of the country and prepare the
students accordingly to fill up those needs. Many of the programme undertaken by the
college focus on innovation and entrepreneurship with an aim to contribute to national
progress and development on all fronts.
   The college strives for the inculcation of values like justice, non-violence, equality,
secularism and a passion for knowledge in the young minds so that they can develop a
scientific and ethical approach to the problems of our society while not sacrificing the
richness and diversity of our culture and heritage.
   Guwahati College is making rapid strides towards its goal of producing not only students
with nearly flawless academic report cards but also a sensible and responsible intelligentsia
who are well aware of the social and ethical responsibility that a truly modern education vest
in them. Objectives of the college are
 To encourage the students to find out their potential.
 To produce high quality students
 To produce ideal citizens for fulfillment of social obligations.
 To develop research culture among the students as well as faculties.
 To promote co-curricular activities amongst the students.
 Creation of social awareness.
 Inculcating moral values

College Emblem:
The College emblem with its motto is highly suggestive of the institution's mission and
vision. In appearance, the emblem resembles a lotus in partial bloom. This highlights the
Nationalistic spirit that prevails in the College. It also suggests opportunity for the students to
prosper. This image further emphasizes the optimistic spirit that forms the basis of the
mission of the College, which is "the will to develop and improve further".
   The figure of the open book implies the propagation of education while the alternate dark
and white lines suggest the College's endeavor to reach out to humanity in its entirety without
any prejudice against caste, creed or color. The earthen lamp, illuminating the surroundings
to remove any darkness of ignorance, forms the motto of spreading the light of knowledge.
The small dots represent the multitude that is expected to be benefitted by the propagation of
knowledge.

 Attendance Requirements
 To be eligible to appear at a University Examination every student has to attend a
   minimum of 75% of the lectures, practical and tutorials held during the academic session.
 The principal shall have the power to strike off the name of a student who is grossly
   irregular in attendance.
 Students remaining absent on medical grounds should submit a medical certificate from
   the appropriate authority while rejoining college. However, absence on medical grounds
   does not mean that they will be exempted from any kind of examination.


Discipline
The college expects its student to conduct themselves in a disciplined and dignified manner in
the college and outside. Students must follow the following rules:
1. Students are responsible for their conduct and are prohibited from doing anything, either
   inside or outside the college that will amount to a breach of discipline or interference in
   the discipline and normal working of the college.
2. Interference of any outside pressure group in the internal affairs of the college is strictly
   prohibited.
3. Students are expected to have regard and consideration for each other and be respectful to
   the teachers, members of the college staff and fellow students.
4. Unbecoming language or ungentlemanly conduct shall be severely dealt with.
5. Students shall maintain perfect silence in classrooms and desist from disorderly behaviour.
   They are expected not to walk about or make noise in the corridors or in front of
   classrooms and must keep as quiet as possible at all times. During their free periods
   students should work quietly in the Library or Reading Room, or spend the time in the
   Students Common Room, but without causing any disturbance.
6. Students shall take proper care of the college property, furniture and premises. They must
   not cause damage to or tamper with college property, furniture and fittings.
7. Students shall leave their bicycles, scooters or motorcycles locked in the parking shed
   provided for this purpose. No bicycle, scooter or motorcycle shall be parked in any other
   part of the college campus.
8. No society can be formed in the college nor shall any person be invited to address a
   meeting in the college without the permission of the Principal.
9. Notices designed to be pasted or circulated by the students anywhere in the college
   premises shall require the approval of the Principal.



                                                                                                   12
 10. Students shall not spoil or misuse the lawns or any other space of the college.
11. Communal harmony must be maintained.
12. Students suffering from any contagious or infectious diseases will not be permitted to
    attend the college. They will be allowed to rejoin classes only after producing a fitness
    certificate from the appropriate authority.
13. It is mandatory for students to come to college in proper College uniform during class
    days as well as on other working days.
14. Smoking, chewing tobacco and spitting betel-nut inside the college campus is considered
    as a punishable event.
15. Students shall not loiter around in college uniform outside the college campus.
16. Parents / Guardians must monitor their wards during their study in the College.


Ragging:
Ragging in any form is strictly prohibited within the college premises or outside the campus.
Guwahati College is committed to provide a ragging free academic environment to the
students. The college in principle adheres to the UGC Regulations on curbing the menace of
ragging in higher educational institutions, 2009 and accordingly constituted an anti-ragging
committee to ensure a ragging-free campus. Any act of the following will be considered as an
act of ragging:
 Involvement in physical assault or threat or use of physical force.
 Violation of the status, dignity, and honor of students.
 Expose students to ridicule and contempt and affect their self-esteem.
   Entail verbal abuse and aggression, indecent gestures, and obscene behavior


Monitoring of academic progress:
The Principal, teachers, IQAC and the academic monitoring cell of the college make regular
effort during the academic session to make first-hand assessments of the academic progress
of the students or any problems related to teaching and learning.


Guardians meet:
Guardians meet is conducted regularly for interaction between the Principal, teachers and
parents/ guardians of students. Guardians are encouraged to attend such meetings to express
their opinions on academic and other developmental matters of their wards.

                                Facilities and Features
1. Academic Calendar and Class Schedule
The academic calendar is available in the college website. Time-table will be available during
the commencement of the new session.


2. Travelling Concession
Students are entitled to railway/air concessions to and from their homes during vacation and
for travelling on academic tours organized by the college.


3. Students Aid Fund
The college has instituted a student aid fund. The objectives of the fund are:
(a) To render financial assistance to the economically backward and deserving students
whose father’s /guardian’s income falls below BPL norms of the Government.
(b) To meet any other need of the students considered to be genuine by the College authority.
A student requiring financial aid shall have to apply to the Principal of the College with an
income certificate given by the competent authority.


4. Students’ Association and Co-curricular Activities
Guwahati College Students’ Union society is the general body of the students of this college.
Every student of the college is a member of this Society. The office bearers of the union are
elected annually. The Union endeavors to promote fraternity, mutual understanding, and a
sense of responsibility among the students and work for the all-round development of the
college. The Union also organizes games and sports, debating, and cultural activities among
the students, under the guidance of the teachers and the college authority.


5. The College Magazine
The Guwahati College Magazine is published annually. The Magazine publishes articles by
teachers, students, and office staff and reviews of the educational, cultural, social, and sports
activities of the college. The magazine is edited by a student editor under the supervision of a
member of the teaching staff. The college also publishes an annual news bulletin.




                                                                                                    16
 6. Library
Guwahati College Central Library was established with the establishment of the College in
the year 1964. S. P. Bhattacharya, retired professor of the department of Bengali of the
College was the In-Charge Librarian till qualified librarian Shri Nagen Talukdar joined the
service in 1976. The Library has very good collection of textbooks, reference books, journals,
popular journals etc and caters to the needs of the readers. The modern library services and
facilities have been progressively implemented to keep track with the changing scenario of
library services. The present three-storey library building was inaugurated on 3rd August,
2016 by the then Education Minister of Assam, Honourable Dr. Himanta Biswa Sarma.
   The College has a well-stocked three-storey central library. The library is open from 9 am
to 4 pm on all days except Sundays and holidays. Students can borrow books from the library
for two weeks. The library is well equipped with a Xerox machine, internet facility, and airy
and spacious reading rooms for teachers and students. SOUL 2.0 software is being used for
library automation. N-List (INFLIBNET) is available in the library. The entire library is
under CCTV surveillance. 12 numbers of CC cameras have been installed for the purpose. 10
numbers of computers are there for Internet browsing. The library has reading room seating
capacity of 80 numbers in reference and Textbook section. Other sections like periodical
section, rare book section, UNESCO Corner have separate reading room facility. Moreover
work to have cloud based Institutional Repository using D-Space software has also been
started. The digital library facilitates in viewing and downloading various in-house
publications like College magazine, bulletin, etc. The library subscribes to a large number of
dailies, weeklies, periodicals, and journals on a variety of subjects. Membership to the
library, issue/return of books, and searching/referencing of books, all this information can be
obtained from the Librarian. Books on loan with members can be recalled at any time if
necessary. Books kept in the reserve section are not issued on loan.


7. College Notice Board
All important notices and information to students are displayed on the Notice board. Students
are advised to see the notice board regularly.


8. Career Counseling cum Placement Cell
Guwahati College has a career counselling cell. The Cell endeavors to produce quality-
oriented manpower and serves as the vital bridge between industry and academia




                                                                                                  17
 facilitating student placements, internships, and training across diverse sectors like banking,
finance, manufacturing, R&D etc. The cell organizes counseling sessions with in-house
faculty or experts from outside. The cell subscribes to employment news and weekly
employment news and displays relevant news on the notice board. Campus interviews are
conducted for placement into various MNCs, nationalized banks etc. Over the past several
years students from Guwahati College successfully secure placements in educational and
state government institutions by appearing through APSC/ADRE selection process.


9. Internal Complaint Committee (ICC)
The grievance redressal cell and ICC of the college look into the grievance or complaint of a
teacher/ student/ parent/ staff. A grievance or a complaint can be conveyed in writing to the
cell in the prescribed form.


10. NCC
The college has a full-fledged national cadet corps, army wing, for both boys and girls.
Regular training is imparted throughout the year by trained NCC officers. There are many
award and scholarship schemes for eligible cadets including Vir Chilarai Award, Sahara
scholarship etc. It is worth mentioning that NCC ‘C’ certificate holders have various
opportunities for Govt. services and for getting scholarships like entry in defense services,
telecommunications, etc., Youth exchange program, community development, personality
development, adventure training, and shooting are being taught to the cadets in the regular
Sunday classes in the college premises. Students willing to join the NCC can contact the
respective Professors-in-charge after the commencement of the academic session.

11. NSS
The National Service Scheme unit of the college is actively engaged in various community
welfare services. Under this scheme, the college unit has shown its proficiency not only at the
state or regional level but also in the national as well as in the international scenario. NSS
Guwahati College strives to develop the personality of students as well as its volunteers
through community service. It aims at channelizing the energy of the youth by engaging them


                                                                                                  18
 in events that serve the greater good and also uphold the motto of NSS, which is “Not Me,
But You”. Students desiring to join the NSS can contact the respective programme officer
after the commencement of the academic session.

12. Sports
The college maintains a good playground where football, volleyball and cricket are played.
Students of the college have consistently performed well in inter-college competitions at the
youth meet organized by GU.


13. History Study Centre
The department of History has started this centre in the year 1999, with a view to popularize
and promote the study of history.


14. The Disaster Management Cell
The college has constituted a disaster management cell. The objective of this cell is to create
awareness amongst people to face any kind of natural hazard like earthquake, flood, cyclone
etc. and prepare them to learn to survive such calamities.


15. Guwahati College Women’s Forum
The Guwahati College women’s forum was set up with the prime objective of helping girl
students of the College in extra-curricular activities and making women of neighboring areas
aware of hygiene and socio-economic matters. The forum organizes various programme
related to women issues.


16. Alumni Association
The college has an Alumni association. Alumni can enroll as well as communicate through
our website: www.guwahaticollege.org.in.


17. Mountaineering Club
The college has a mountaineering club registered under Assam rock and sport climbing
association (ARSCA) affiliated to Indian mountaineering foundation. The club was
established in the year 1985. The aim of the club is to promote adventure sports and


                                                                                                  19
 mountaineering skills among students under the technical support of ARSCA. The club was
established in the year 1985. The club also organizes adventure camps and basic skills of rock
climbing regularly.


18. Skill Development and Entrepreneurship Cell
Skill development and entrepreneurship cell is constituted in the College and has been
successfully conducting student-centric activities. The cell has been instrumental in
facilitating industry-institution linkage and trained under NSIC. Students are mentored to
engage in Skill based activities and develop entrepreneurial temperament.


19. Institution Innovation Cell (IIC)
Ministry of education (MOE), Govt. of India has established innovation cells in all higher
educational institutions to systematically foster the culture of Innovation amongst all HEIs.
The college has initiated an IIC involving a number of faculties, domain experts and students.


20. Eco Club
Eco club of Guwahati College is a part of Environment Education Programme (EEP), an
initiative of ministry of environment, forest and climate change (MoEFCC). The eco club
works to inculcate sustainable and eco-friendly practices in the campus. The eco club of
Guwahati College has been recognized as an excellent eco club by Govt. of Assam for the
year 2021-2022.


21. Electoral Literacy Club (ELC)
Through the ELCs, the Election Commission of India aims at strengthening the culture of
electoral participation among young and future voters. Through the ELC, the college engages
college students to familiarize them with the electoral process. The club has faculty members
as conveners and student members as campus ambassadors.


22. Ecotreato
It is a platform for direct sales and promotion of handmade products and services initiated by
the department of Economics. Through this platform, assistance and support is provided to
students who wish to trade in any kinds of handmade products and services.

 23. Yoga and Meditation Cell
Guwahati College has been running a yoga and meditation centre in the college. The yoga
and meditation centre was started for both students and staff with a lot of objectives like
making students understand the importance of maintaining good health, both physically and
mentally, to have an understanding of life and peaceful living, educating students on the
spiritual dimension and how it affects our lives, teaching yoga methods of warding of
unnecessary stress and improving concentration. The yoga and meditation centre conducts
sessions on both theoretical and practical aspects of yoga and meditation.


24. Science Orientation Centre for Undergraduate Students
The main goal of this centre is to motivate the undergraduate students towards research. This
centre also incubates various scientific ideas at grass root level. Time to time, various
workshops are organized under SOCUS for the school students to develop scientific
temperament among them.


25. Incubation Centre
Guwahati College has an incubation center to promote entrepreneurship growth among
students and the community. The center organizes awareness campaigns, seminars, lectures,
and industry visits and offers guidance on obtaining loans and financial aid from public and
private institutions for budding entrepreneurs.
